//: SOURCE-ONLY PACKAGE — do not 'fix' the fields below to point at dist/.
main/types/exports resolve to TypeScript source on purpose: the only
consumers are Vite (apps/desktop), Metro (apps/mobile) and tsc, all of
which compile TS directly. Pointing at dist/ would require a build step
before every app start and would break hot reload across packages.
`npm run build` still emits dist/ — for declaration output and CI
